recent_en: Verdant Solar reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue up 14% year-on-year to RM22.9 million and profit before tax rising 28%. The company changed its financial year end in September and made several 'OTHERS' announcements. In the news, the stock was repeatedly featured among momentum stocks on Bursa Malaysia.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM22.9 million and profit before tax up 28%.
risks_en: TGS TW stepped down as auditor for the company, along with several other listed companies.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM20.043 million, net profit RM1.532 million, net margin 7.6%, revenue up 128.5% quarter-on-quarter, versus a net margin of -22.6% in the previous quarter.
